findings: All tested Domain configurations produced exactly one model through 1800 seconds and again through roughly 2800 seconds.
Removing --opt-heuristic=sign,model reproducibly changed the endpoint from [-704,-46523] to [-704,-46547] but did not shorten the plateau.
Restart counts from 0 to 9496 changed first-model basin and timing but did not produce a second model.
VSIDS without objective heuristics emitted 1061 mechanical linear-descent models but plateaued at lexicographically inferior [-656,-38696].
The user selected the 24-point endpoint improvement; Makefile PROP_FLAGS was updated accordingly.
Exact revised flags passed the manual example; the propagator suite passed 62 checks before a missing generated ooex0.lp fixture aborted it.

config.goal: Improve long-term TinyXml performance while testing objective heuristics and restart cadence.
config.metric: late TinyXml incumbent progress with lexicographic cost as endpoint tiebreaker
